memory_candidates.content: The principal filter map from a HilbertAlgebra H to HilbertFilter H is order-reversing and gives only a half-morphism for himp: principal(a himp b) <= principal(a) himp principal(b) but NOT equality. The reverse inequality is provably FALSE (counterexample: himpFilter(principal a)(principal a) = topFilter but principal(a himp a) = bot). This means principal_le_algEvaluate gives the WRONG direction for conservative extension proofs that need to bridge HAValid to HilbertValid. A himp-PRESERVING embedding (with equality) requires a different construction such as the Dedekind-MacNeille completion.

HilbertFilter H can be made into a HeytingAlgebra by defining Compl via compl F := F himp bot and proving himp_bot by rfl. This works because HilbertFilter already has GeneralizedHeytingAlgebra (from DiegoEmbedding.lean) and OrderBot (from CompleteLattice). The construction was verified to compile in Lean.
